The structure of Cs4Sb2Cl12 (reduced formula Cs2SbCl6) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Sb centers coordinated by six Cl neighbors at 2.6753 Å, while Cs centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Cl neighbors at 3.8352 Å. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cs and Sb polyhedra and face-sharing between Cs polyhedra.
